## Key

| Article Title | Long-term recovery of Mediterranean ant and bee communities after fire in southern Spain |
| --- | --- |
| Authors | J. Manuel Vidal-Cordero, Elena Angulo, Francisco P. Molina, Raphaël Boulay and Xim Cerdá |
| Corresponding author | xim@ebd.csic.es |

| File Dataset_S1 | Contains the data analysed in this article |
| --- | --- |

| Spreadsheets | data.ants: contains the values of the taxonomic indices, functional indices, and functional traits for each ant sampling transect as well as the values for the associated environmental variables |
| --- | --- |
|  | data.bees: contains the values of the taxonomic indices, functional indices, and functional traits for each bee sampling transect as well as the values for the associated environmental variables |
|  | data.veg: contains the data on the vegetation strata for each transect |

| ant.matrix: contains the data used to calculate the taxonomic indices |
| --- |
| bee.matrix: contains the data used to calculate the taxonomic indices |
| ant.traits: contains the full list of traits for each species, along with references and detailed descriptions |
| bee.traits: contains the full list of traits for each species, along with references and detailed descriptions |
| references: contains the main references for the ant and bee traits |
